Hey Product Hunt 👋   
  
I'm Tyler, co-founder and CEO of Overmind.

Overmind is the open-source platform for AI agent training. What we're working towards is giving every product its own AI lab. 🚀

Most AI products run on the same few frontier models. A frontier lab works differently, collecting data, building evals, training, testing. Ship and repeat.

> We wanted any team building an agent to be able to run that same loop on its own data, without hiring an ML team or building infrastructure.

To get started: Connect our MCP, and paste one prompt into Cursor, Claude Code, Codex or OpenCode.

What you get: [...] We kept one test in our heads the whole time: can someone who has never fine-tuned a model go from one prompt in their coding agent to their own model in production? Making the answer yes is what the whole team spent the last few months on.

It is all open source, so if something looks off, open an issue or come find me in the comments. Happy to go as deep as you want on the technical side!

Toodaloo 👋
